blocks.text: Thailand’s Culture Minister Sabida Thaised on Oct. 25, 2026, rejected Cambodia’s demand for the return of artifacts, asserting that Prasat Ta Kwai and Prasat Khana, two temples along the Thai-Cambodian border, belong to Thailand. Sabida said the Culture Ministry would prepare a formal response to a letter dated Oct. 22 from Cambodia’s Ministry of Culture
